summary: Tested OPS dashboard (Phase 1) - backend + frontend. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_ops_dashboard.py with 31 tests covering AUTH/RBAC for all 4 staff roles, dashboard stats, vendors CRUD + notes + status, menu management with default discount, availability->drops reflection, orders/users/payouts/settings, roles/staff/search, and mobile regression (drops shape, drop detail, vendor endpoints, order create+verify with subtotal*1.10 paise). All 31/31 PASS. Frontend: verified /ops on web for all 3 RBAC roles - operations shows only Dashboard/Vendors/Orders/Settings (no Users/Payouts); finance shows Dashboard/Vendors/Orders/Payouts/Settings (no Users); admin (anubhavg@perfectlygood.in/Anubhavv) shows ALL 6 nav items. Vendor detail page (Green Leaf Bakery) renders full profile + menu items with toggle/edit/duplicate/delete + payout history + internal notes section. Payouts page renders vendor settlement table with Mark Paid action and CSV export. Settings page shows commission/GST/categories/pickup slots/service types/staff list/role matrix correctly. Backend smoke logs show finance->POST /api/ops/vendors -> 403, ops->/api/ops/dashboard/stats -> 200.

minor.issue: active_vendors counts vendors with status != 'inactive', so vendors missing the status field (legacy seed data) are counted as active. Fine for now since OPS create sets status='active' explicitly.

pending_payout can become negative (-₹1,102 observed for Green Leaf Bakery) when historical payouts exceed current 'picked_up' revenue. Display shows negative number. Consider clamping at 0 or showing 'Over-paid'.

integration_issues.issue: Finance role sees 'Add Vendor' and 'Upload Menu' quick action cards on Dashboard even though they lack manage_vendors/manage_menu perms. Clicking will 403. Should be hidden per-role.

issues: ACTIONS column gets clipped on the right edge at 1440 width; horizontal scroll needed
Multiple duplicate 'Test Vendor' rows visible from prior iteration leftovers - not a code bug, just test data pollution
Pending Payout displays '₹-1,102' (negative) - confusing for user; should clamp

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Multiple components use deprecated shadow* props in StyleSheet. Reference: throughout app/ops/*.tsx and shared style modules.

Console warning: "[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect." The push token listener is registered on web preview but not effective. Wrap in Platform.OS !== 'web' check.

action_items: (Minor) Hide 'Add Vendor' / 'Upload Menu' quick actions on Dashboard for roles lacking manage_vendors / manage_menu permissions (currently shown to Finance).
(Minor) Clamp pending_payout display at 0 (or add 'Over-paid' badge) on vendor detail + payouts list when value is negative.
(Cleanup) Many 'Test Vendor' / 'TEST_*' rows are left in the DB from prior test iterations. Consider a manual DB cleanup before launch.
(Polish) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow across StyleSheets; wrap expo-notifications push-token listener with Platform.OS !== 'web' guard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1196 -> pending_payouts uses max(net - paid, 0) so dashboard stat already clamps at 0. But /api/ops/payouts (line 1619) does NOT clamp pending_payout, hence negative shown in UI.

server.py:1617 -> 'all_net = revenue * (1 - 0.15 * 1.18)' applies commission+GST correctly across ALL picked_up orders; verified math: total_sales*0.15 commission, commission*0.18 GST, net = sales - commission - gst.
server.py:2063 -> file is ~2063 lines; consider splitting OPS endpoints (lines 1099-1763) into a separate router module to improve maintainability.
server.py:1488 -> /api/ops/menu/{id}/availability correctly toggles `available_today`; verified end-to-end with /api/drops reflection (test_availability_reflects_in_drops).
server.py:1414-1416 -> default discounted_price computed as original_price * (1 - default_discount_pct/100); verified 200*(1-0.4)=120 in test.
server.py:513 -> /api/orders/create still queries menu_items with available_today=True, so migration is consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical paths (login redirects, RBAC sidebar, vendor list/detail, menu actions visible, payouts list, settings render). Minor RBAC visibility polish needed.

seed_data_creation: Tests create then delete TEST_Vendor_OPS, TEST_MenuVendor, TEST_staff_*, TEST_cust_* with cleanup fixtures. One ₹1 payout marked against first vendor (Spice Garden) for assertion but not cleaned up since payout history is append-only.
